thread:
anna_cs: Hey team — kicking off Nectar onboarding this week. Stakeholders we met: @maria_pm (Nectar PM) and @derek_it (Nectar infra). Our goals for sprint-0 (10 days): 1) RedwoodHosted API in their support flow, 2) baseline latency & cost, 3) Enablement for their CSMs on Console. Need owners, access, and any immediate blockers.

maria_pm: Thanks Anna — I can coordinate from the Nectar side. Prefer weekly sync Tues 10am PT. I'll intro Derek + their SRE in an email after this.

raj_success: I'll own success criteria and the onboarding acceptance tests. Suggested criteria: < 300ms 95th p50 for common prompts, end-to-end support flow validated in staging, and CSMs complete the Console runbook.

oliver_se: I'll take model selection + integration support. Need their staging API keys + sample prompts. Also they use a webhook-based ticket flow — please share example payloads.

jamie_pm: Adding a sprint-0 board now and a rough timeline. Link: https://projects.redwood.internal/nectar-onboard (private). I'll add three columns: to-do, blocked, verified.

anna_cs: Action items from initial: 1) maria to intro Derek & SRE (by EOD) 2) nectar to share staging keys + sample payloads (by Day 2) 3) oliver to pair on model selection (Day 1-3) 4) raj to draft acceptance tests (Day 2) 5) jamie to create tickets and owner assignments (today). Callout: renewal risk flagged if we miss go-live by Day 30 — we should capture any legal/infra gating items now.

derek_it: Quick infra note — Nectar requires VPC peering for webhooks. I'll open a ticket with our infra team; expected 48-72h. If peering delayed, we'll route via a secure proxy.

onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist (public): /docs/onboarding/nectar-checklist — includes Console runbook, API quickstart, and evaluation prompt set.

oliver_se: Small code snippet to sanity-test generation against our hosted API (share this with their engs):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize this ticket: <body>"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maria_pm: ACK, sending intros now. Also note: compliance wants data residency confirmed — Nectar is EU-first; can we confirm region availability for Dedicated or Hosted fallbacks?

anna_cs: Good catch. raj, can you confirm region routing options and fallback policies for EU data residency by tomorrow?

raj_success: On it — will validate routing + SLA tiers. If Dedicated required, we'll estimate cost delta and present options in the next sync.

jamie_pm: I'll schedule the first check-in for Tue 10am PT and invite Derek, Maria, Oliver, Raj, and Anna. Calendar link TBD.

anna_cs: Closing note — small ask for feedback after first 48h: what was unclear in setup, anything missing in the Console runbook. We'll capture to avoid churn later. :thumbsup:

maria_pm: Sounds good — excited to get started.

oliver_se: Quick question — any preference on prompts to start benchmarking? I recommend 10 representative tickets (varied length/complexity).

maria_pm: I'll export 10 anonymized tickets and drop them in the shared folder by EOD tomorrow.

anna_cs: Perfect. I'll compile an initial acceptance test doc and post it in the sprint board before the first sync. Thanks everyone!

(onboarding thread ended)
